name: Knowledge Watch
description: Keeps the CBO up to date on his industry, the technologies and the topics he follows: AI models and providers, hyperscalers and cloud, sovereign AI and policy, data centres, GPUs and power, the Gulf and UAE market, and the competitors and partners that matter. He chooses the knowledge categories and the topics in each. A researcher agent scans the web a few times a week and files dated, sourced items; an editor agent writes one weekly digest, sent by chat and email and filed as a note in the vault.

flavours.name: Knowledge Watch
flavours.description: The one way this plugin works. Every setting is optional: empty means the default, and each can be changed later on the plugin's Settings page.

config.label: Vault folder
config.hint: Where the weekly digest note is filed. Empty means Work/Knowledge Watch.

config.label: Preferred sources
config.hint: Comma list of domains the researcher looks at first. Empty means the list the plugin ships.

config.label: Blocked sources
config.hint: Comma list of domains never filed. Empty means none.

config.label: Look back (days)
config.hint: How far back a scan looks when a category was never scanned. Empty means 7.

config.label: Items per category per scan
config.hint: The most a scan files for one category. Empty means 6.

config.label: How the web is scanned
config.hint: Your own instructions for the researcher. Empty means the prompt the plugin ships.

config.label: How the digest is written
config.hint: Your house style for the weekly digest. Empty means the prompt the plugin ships.
